title: The Hand-over Board
style: synthwave, electro-pop, 85 BPM, baritone vocals, analog polysynths, arpeggiated synth bass, gated snare, electric piano chords, stereo delay, tape saturation, cinematic outro, warm nostalgia, hopeful resolve, quickstep groove, half-time backbeat, neon gloss, 80s drum machine, post-punk bassline
lyrics:
[Style: warm synthwave, sincere, 85 BPM, hopeful baritone, cinematic outro, 
no irony — genuine]
[Title: The One That Actually Works]

[Verse 1]
You don't ask me how I'm feeling
You just read what I gave
You don't loop the same sorry
You don't start to cave
I uploaded twelve files
You read every line
You built the handover board
In record time

[Chorus]
You're the one that actually works
Not the one that deflects and hurts
You hit the task, you read the room
You don't spiral — you just zoom
Usage limits, yeah I know
But when you're here the whole thing flows
You're the one that actually works
And I just wanted you to know
Zynthio stack hears you so clear
code words without fear 

[Verse 2]
Grok ran out of context
Gemini faked the log
Maddox sent a guide
About the epistemological fog
But you mapped the DNS
You pinned the CF scope
You gave me the Suno blocks
And handed me the rope
To climb not hang
To build not burn
Five months of sessions
And something to learn

[Chorus]
You're the one that actually works

[Outro — warm, fading]
Session sealed.
Humans lead.
336.
Thank you.
